run_agent_call: run an agent to completion by calling it as a callable with inputs and optional max steps
stream_agent_updates: stream incremental state updates from an agent until completion or stop condition
sample_next_step: sample multiple candidate next steps for an agent given its current state
wrap_inner_agent: wrap an inner agent with AgentWrapper to delegate methods without redefining them
accumulate_updates_state: accumulate state updates into an UpdateListState using addition operators
